ticket.summary: New customer at 220 Percheron Rd reports rotten-egg/sulfur smell near basement water heater (plus week-long slow floor drain and musty odor) - treated as suspected gas leak, customer evacuating and calling gas utility/911; on-call paged.
mitigation_advice: Leave the building immediately with everyone and pets; do not return until the utility clears it [PB-06]
Do not operate light switches, appliances, or phones inside the house [PB-06]
From outside, call the gas utility's emergency line or 911 - do not stop to call indoors [PB-06]
ticket.customer_message: Get out first - call from outside. Don't stop to make the call indoors; walk everyone straight out the door, then dial the gas utility's emergency line or 911 from the sidewalk or a neighbor's [PB-06]. Don't go back in for anything until they clear it. Address confirmed: 220 Percheron Rd. Our on-call plumber is being paged now and will coordinate after the utility has checked the line. Please don't re-enter or use any switches in the meantime.
